items.title: On building systems that last
items.body: The hardest part of backend engineering is not writing the feature — it is writing it in a way your future self will still understand at 2am during an incident.

items.title: Queues over cron jobs
items.body: Cron jobs are easy until they overlap. A durable queue turns 'run this later' into a guarantee instead of a hope.
